bounds: One known-unapplied candidate, six retained-byte equality classes, one external file-lock owner and at most two HTTP requests. Calls are observed after their real FileLock and filesystem effects settle. No applied payload or journal authority is reset.

assumptions: One stable known-unapplied candidate; the private directory remains available with sufficient space.
No peer holds the file lock. HTTP serves exact valid bytes; filesystem IO and rename succeed.
Calls through attempt(valid) are weakly fair. This is not a scheduling or wall-time guarantee.
No call fairness is assumed; stuttering can leave the corrupt partial unprocessed forever.
